blocks.title: Ask this page
blocks.description: A question box that answers from the page's own content, with follow-ups.

blocks.title: Explain selection
blocks.description: Select any text on the page, a small "Explain" button appears next to it.

blocks.title: Summarize this page
blocks.description: Three buttons, three lengths, answer streams in.

blocks.title: Translate this page
blocks.description: One button, the main content is rewritten in the visitor's browser language.

blocks.title: FAQ bot
blocks.description: Answers only from the FAQ you wrote; says "I don't know" otherwise.

blocks.title: Draft a reply
blocks.description: Paste a message, pick a tone, get a reply you can edit.

blocks.title: Rewrite
blocks.description: Shorter, longer, formal or friendly, applied to any text box.

blocks.title: Extract to JSON
blocks.description: Paste messy text, get structured fields back as an object.

blocks.title: Smart search
blocks.description: Describe what you want in plain words, the matching items on the page get highlighted.

blocks.title: Describe an image
blocks.description: Pick a photo, get alt text; works with any on the page too.

blocks.title: Explain code
blocks.description: An "Explain" button on every code block on the page.

blocks.title: Quiz from content
blocks.description: Turns the page (or any element) into three multiple-choice questions.
